title: test_user_login_with_valid_credentials
description: Verify that POST /api/auth/login with valid username and password returns 200 with an ApiResponse envelope whose data object contains accessToken and expiresIn, and that the accessToken can be used to access protected endpoints.

title: test_create_new_user
description: Verify that POST /api/users with a unique, randomly-generated username and password creates a new user and returns 201 Created (not 200 -- this API returns 201 for all resource-creation endpoints) with ApiResponse.data as UserDto, and that the user can be retrieved and assigned roles. CRITICAL: POST /api/users/search does NOT accept a flat JSON body like {"username": "x"} -- it requires the standard search-contract shape: {"filters": [{"field": "username", "operator": "EQUALS", "value": "<username>"}], "page": 0, "size": 20}. A flat body returns 400 INVALID_JSON. Use this exact filters array shape for the search step.

title: test_create_role_with_valid_data
description: Verify that POST /api/roles with a unique, randomly-generated roleCode, roleName, and description creates a new role and returns 201 Created (not 200) with ApiResponse.data as RoleDto. IMPORTANT: roleCode must match the server-side validation pattern ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$ (starts with an uppercase letter, then only uppercase letters/digits/underscore -- no lowercase, no leading digit) or the request fails with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR; build it like 'TEST_ROLE_' + a random uppercase-hex/digit suffix, not a raw lowercase uuid. Always delete the created role in a finally block regardless of assertion outcome, using the id captured immediately after creation, so it doesn't leak into other tests.

title: test_create_page_and_autogenerate_permissions
description: Verify that POST /api/pages with a unique, randomly-generated pageCode and valid page data creates a page and auto-generates CRUD permissions, returning 201 Created (not 200) with ApiResponse.data as PageResponse. Note: the backend normalizes pageCode to uppercase server-side (PageService.createPage), so assert the returned pageCode equals the input pageCode uppercased/trimmed, not a raw string match.

title: test_create_legal_entity
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/org/legal-entities with valid data creates a legal entity and returns 201 Created (not 200) with ApiResponse.data as LegalEntityResponse, for the currently authenticated SUPER_ADMIN user. IMPORTANT: BOTH nameEn AND nameAr have independent global unique constraints (409 ALREADY_EXISTS/NAME_DUPLICATE on repeat if EITHER matches an existing row) -- build a single randomized suffix (e.g. uuid4 hex or timestamp) and append it to BOTH nameEn and nameAr, never use a fixed/hardcoded literal for either field, since the database persists across test runs.

title: test_create_master_lookup
description: Verify that POST /api/masterdata/master-lookups with a unique, randomly-generated lookupKey and names creates a master lookup and returns 201 Created (not 200) with ApiResponse.data as MasterLookupResponse. IMPORTANT: the backend normalizes lookupKey to uppercase server-side (MasterLookupService), so assert the returned lookupKey equals the input lookupKey uppercased, not a raw case-sensitive match.

title: test_issue_file_upload_token_and_upload_file
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/files/upload-token issues a valid encrypted upload token (in ApiResponse.data). Then verify that POST /upload/{encryptedToken} with multipart file uploads the file successfully. THIS IS CRITICAL AND CONFIRMED BY LIVE CURL TEST -- BOTH of these two separate POST calls return HTTP status 201 (Created), NOT 200. Do not assert 200 on either call: assert response.status_code == 201 for the upload-token call, AND assert response.status_code == 201 for the multipart upload call. The upload response's ApiResponse.data contains the file name under the key 'fileNameOriginal' (not 'fileName' or 'originalFileName') -- assert on that exact key.

title: test_send_notification_immediately
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/notifications/send with a valid notification payload (recipientId referencing an existing user, channelHint as an uppercase channel code list e.g. ["EMAIL"], priority one of HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW, moduleCode and templateCode as non-blank strings) sends the notification immediately and returns 201 Created (not 200) with ApiResponse.data as NotificationSendConfirmation containing a non-empty logEntryIds array.

title: test_get_user_menu_for_current_user
description: Verify that GET /api/menu/user-menu with valid JWT returns 200 with ApiResponse.data as the hierarchical menu filtered by VIEW permissions for the current user.

title: test_assign_branch_scope_to_role
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/security/role-branches with a freshly-created role and a valid branchIdFk and dataAccessLevel assigns branch-level data access scope to that role and returns 201 Created (not 200) with ApiResponse.data as SecRoleBranchDto. IMPORTANT: when creating the role, roleCode must match the server-side validation pattern ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$ (starts with an uppercase letter, then only uppercase letters/digits/underscore) or role creation fails with 400; build it like 'TEST_ROLE_' + a random uppercase-hex/digit suffix. roleName ALSO has a unique constraint (409 DUPLICATE_ROLE_NAME on repeat) -- append the same random suffix to roleName too, never a fixed literal like 'Test Role for Branch Scope'. Also, RoleDto's id field is named 'id', not 'roleId' -- read role_data['id']. CRITICAL: dataAccessLevel is a lookup-driven enum with ONLY these three valid active values: 'BRANCH_ONLY', 'BRANCH_AND_CHILDREN', 'ALL' -- plain 'BRANCH' or 'Branch' is INVALID and returns 400 SEC_ROLE_BRANCH_DATA_ACCESS_LEVEL_REQUIRED; use 'BRANCH_ONLY' exactly.

title: test_notification_unread_endpoint_returns_known_422
description: Verify that GET /api/v1/notifications/unread returns HTTP 422 with error code NOTIF_READ_TRACKING_UNAVAILABLE, matching the documented known limitation (no read/unread column in NOTIF_LOG). This is the expected, correct behavior -- do not treat the 422 itself as a failure.

title: test_login_with_invalid_credentials_returns_401
description: Verify that POST /api/auth/login with an invalid username/password returns a 401/error ApiResponse envelope with success:false, and that protected endpoints reject requests without a valid Authorization header.
